name: cascader
purpose: Selects a node in a hierarchy through cascading columns, such as country > state > city or category > subcategory. A trigger button opens a non-modal popup with a search box and one listbox per level; children can load lazily with loading, error, and retry states. Single or multiple selection; the trigger shows the selected path. A Form control with hidden inputs carrying the selected leaf values.
whenToUse: Locations, organization units, product categories: hierarchies of two to five levels where each level narrows the next.
Large hierarchies loaded level by level from a server.
whenNotToUse: A flat list: use Select or Combobox.
Deep or irregular trees where users need to see the whole structure: use a tree view.
Two levels with few options: two dependent Selects are simpler.
responsive: The trigger fills its container. The popup shows the columns side by side up to 48rem (or the viewport) and scrolls horizontally beyond that; each level list scrolls vertically.
rtl: Columns run right to left; ArrowLeft opens the next level and ArrowRight goes back; the next-level chevrons are mirrored.
theme: Global tokens only: control surface, popup surface and shadow, selection colors, and the focus ring. Forced colors use Highlight and HighlightText for selected options and CanvasText for the popup border.
security: Labels and paths are rendered with textContent. Loaded children are validated ({ value, label } strings) before use. No HTML is accepted.
dataHandling: Loaded children are cached per node for the component's lifetime (an interrupted or failed load is retried the next time the node opens). No persistence or telemetry; network access happens only inside your loadChildren.

performance.testedScale: Levels of up to 1,000 options and up to 32 levels; search walks every loaded node and lists at most maxResults (default 50) paths.

limitations: Search only finds nodes that are loaded (given in options or loaded earlier); it does not call loadChildren.
A value whose path is not loaded yet shows the raw values for the unknown segments until those levels load.
Columns are not windowed; very long levels (thousands of options) should be loaded lazily or split.
unsupported: Server-side search across unloaded levels (use a Combobox with loadOptions that returns paths).
antiPatterns: Leaving levelLabels out when the levels have names (Country, State, City): the default names are generic.
